reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and getNextDate and adds shared predicates (skipsWeekendOccurrences, isNonWorkingDay), but the new range handler and the other callers rebuild the skip-or-shift handling around them instead of one shared occurrence-adjustment function.

duplication.why: The same 'daily skips non-working days, others shift via getDateWithSkippedWeekend' dispatch, with a lookahead window, is written out separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template's loop, and the window size is computed two different ways (getWeekdayLookahead vs WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS).

placement.why: The weekend and holiday predicates live in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and the new handler sits in schedules/app.ts with the other schedule handlers; only the adjustment policy leaks into each caller.

scope.why: Edits serve the four steps plus tests, docs and a release note; threading holidays and frequency through parseRecurDate fits, and the schedule-template rewrite into closures is a bit more than needed.

maintainability.why: A further change to how non-working days are handled has to be repeated at four call sites, and schedule-template reuses getNextDate's noSkipWeekend flag with an inverted meaning (!skipsWeekendDays), which is hard to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in schedules/app.ts, and createScheduleList in budget/schedule-template.ts, apply skipsWeekendOccurrences/isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend themselves instead of going through getNextDate or one adjust-occurrence helper

disguised_duplication.where: The skip-vs-shift dispatch shows up as a .find filter in getNextDate, a filter/slice chain in getUpcomingDates, a for-loop with continue in getDatesInRange, and getOccurrenceFrom/getEffectiveDate closures in schedule-template: the same logic in four different shapes

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gained a holidays parameter; getNextDate gained the daily-skip branch with its own lookahead; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template's createScheduleList each re-implement the daily-skip/shift decision
